What is an AI coach?

An AI coach is an AI chat that stays in one role. Instead of a blank “ask anything” box, it acts as a mentor, tutor or guide with one job, so its questions and answers stay on your problem. It does not replace a real expert, but it is available at 2 a.m. and never gets tired of follow-up questions.

FocusedOne role per coach, so you get fewer generic answers.
PracticalGood coaches end with a next step you can take today.
Honest about limitsHealth, legal and money decisions still need a qualified person.

How to get good answers from an AI coach

  1. Give it the real situationNumbers, dates, who is involved. “I earn $2,400 and spend $2,600” beats “I’m bad with money”.
  2. Say what you want backA plan, a script, three options, a table. The format you ask for is the format you get.
  3. Ask it to ask you firstAdd “Ask me 3 questions before you answer.” The answer gets much more specific.
  4. Push backIf an answer feels generic, say so. “Too vague, make it fit a 2-person team” works.
  5. End with one actionClose every chat with “What is the one thing I should do today?” and do it.

Questions people ask

Are these AI coaches really free?

Yes, everything on this site is free: the guides, the 12 prompts on each coach page and the example conversations. You can paste the prompts into any AI chat. Talking to the built-in coaches inside the Zehn app needs a Zehn Pro plan, which starts with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan.

Which AI model do the coaches in Zehn use?

In the Zehn AI Chat you choose the model from a picker at the top of the screen. The yearly plan includes all four models: Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and Grok. The monthly plan includes the AI Chat with one model. Each coach keeps the same role whichever model you pick.

Can an AI coach replace a therapist, doctor or financial adviser?

No. An AI coach is good for thinking out loud, preparing questions and building habits, but it does not know your full history and cannot take responsibility for advice. For health, mental health, legal or large money decisions, talk to a qualified professional. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

Who makes Intellect AI?

Intellect AI is made by the team behind Zehn, a book-summary app by Safari Group. Zehn has 10,000+ books in 15–20 minute audio and text summaries, Ask AI on every book and an AI Chat tab with nine coaching personas. This site is a free guide to using those coaches well.
